lodging.manual:
Welcome! 😊
We have prepared this guide to help you enjoy a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Below you will find general information on how the accommodation works:
Climate and Comfort 🌡️
If the property is equipped with air conditioning or heating systems, they are designed for your comfort. We recommend using them responsibly and turning them off when not needed.
Hot Water 🚿
The hot water supply is prepared for standard use during your stay. In some cases, it may be necessary to let the water run for a few seconds.
Appliances ⚡
Available appliances are intended for normal domestic use. We recommend following basic instructions and turning them off after use.
Access to the Property 🔐
The access system has been designed to provide a simple and secure entry. Always use the indicated methods and ensure everything is properly closed when leaving.
If you notice any issues or have any questions, please report them as soon as possible so we can help you.
lodging.schedule:
For better organization, please keep the following in mind:
- Check-in 🧳
Entry to the accommodation must take place within the schedule established by the host.
Check-out 🧹
Departure must be carried out respecting the indicated time, leaving the property in appropriate condition.
Quiet Hours 🌙
It is important to respect periods of silence and rest, especially during the night.
If you require schedule flexibility, we recommend inquiring in advance.
lodging.recycling:
Caring for the environment is a shared responsibility 🌍
- If the property has a recycling system:
Waste Separation
Please use the available bins according to the type of waste.
Outdoor Bins 🚮
Public containers are located in the immediate vicinity of the property.
If you have any questions, please check local signs or consult your host.
lodging.rules:
These rules seek to ensure an enjoyable experience for both you and the surroundings 🤝
Respect and Harmony 🔇
Please maintain an appropriate noise level, especially during quiet hours.
Outside Visitors 👥
Only registered guests should access the property, unless prior authorization is granted by the host.
Caring for the Property 🧼
Please treat the accommodation and its furnishings with the same care as your own home.
Responsible Use 🚭
Respect specific property rules regarding smoking, pets, or other particular conditions.
Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
